error.title: Octop could not start
error.fallback: Octop hit an unexpected error while starting. Open it again.

shell.runtimeTooNew: The runtime already on this computer is {{localVersion}}, and this install is {{bundledVersion}}. Startup stopped so the newer runtime stays in place.
shell.checksumFailed: The bundled runtime failed its SHA-256 check. Startup stopped.
shell.portableFailed: Preparing the portable runtime failed. Startup stopped.
shell.pythonFailed: The Python service did not become ready. Check the log and try again.
shell.devServerFailed: The dashboard dev server did not start, so the page cannot hot reload.
